page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of the lines, so some words there are restored from the sense and the line pattern. Printed spelling is kept, including "Fini.111", "11." and "vtrãque" with its tilde. The catchword "nam" completes the hyphenated "v-" at the line end.
